title: 2016 AMC 10B Problem 19
statement: Rectangle \(ABCD\) has \(AB=5\) and \(BC=4.\) Point \(E\) lies on \(\overline{AB}\) so that \(EB=1,\) point \(G\) lies on \(\overline{BC}\) so that \(CG=1,\) and point \(F\) lies on \(\overline{CD}\) so that \(DF=2.\) Segments \(\overline{AG}\) and \(\overline{AC}\) intersect \(\overline{EF}\) at \(Q\) and \(P,\) respectively. What is the value of \(\dfrac{PQ}{EF}?\)

solutions.text:
We have \(AE=AB-EB=4\) and \(FC=DC-DF=3.\) Since \(AE\parallel FC,\) the triangles \(AEP\) and \(CFP\) are similar. Therefore \[\frac{PF}{PE}=\frac{FC}{AE}=\frac34,\] so \(\frac{PF}{EF}=\frac37.\)

Extend \(AG\) to meet line \(CD\) at \(X.\) Because \(BG=3,\) similarity gives \[\frac{AD}{DX}=\frac{BG}{AB},\qquad \frac4{DX}=\frac35,\] and hence \(DX=\frac{20}{3}\). Thus \(FX=DX-DF=\frac{14}{3}.\) Since \(AE\parallel FX,\) triangles \(AEQ\) and \(XFQ\) are similar, so \[\frac{QF}{QE}=\frac{FX}{AE}=\frac76.\] Consequently \(\frac{QF}{EF}=\frac7{13}.\)

It follows that \[ \begin{aligned} \frac{PQ}{EF}&=\frac{QF}{EF}-\frac{PF}{EF} \\ &=\frac7{13}-\frac37=\frac{10}{91}. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Use similar triangles to express \(\frac{PF}{EF}\) and \(\frac{QF}{EF}\)
